GitHub Plus Maintained

A maintained compatibility fork of GitHub Plus, originally created by PRO-2684.

Published release · v0.7.3 · Maintained fork · GPL-3.0
Release & userscriptSource repository

A more useful GitHub workspace

  • Code-view and sidebar appearance controls
  • Sticky avatars and issue/comment headers
  • File icons, release download counts, and download histograms
  • Extended repository/user information and API rate-limit display

What changed in v0.7.3

Boolean state indicators now appear at the beginning of menu captions so they remain visible in narrow Violentmonkey popups. Long group names are shorter.

Includes earlier repairs for unavailable upstream dependencies and GitHub pages stuck with loading placeholders.

Install or update

  1. Install a userscript manager such as Violentmonkey or Tampermonkey.
  2. Open the v0.7.3 release and install the complete GitHub-Plus.user.js asset using your manager.
  3. Disable older or duplicate GitHub Plus copies, then reload GitHub.
  4. Open the userscript manager’s menu on GitHub to review settings.

No Node.js build is needed for the userscript. A personal access token is optional for API rate limits; do not share tokens in reports. Automatic updates from the original upstream build were removed, so review this maintained repository for updates.

Attribution and compatibility

Original GitHub Plus: PRO-2684. Compatibility repairs and maintenance: KyleAustin85. This is a maintained fork, not an original Purple Dragon implementation. GitHub interface changes may require further compatibility fixes. The compact Catppuccin fallback pack is not the original full resource database.
